response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON ab.translink = tx.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, analysis_count,
         analysis_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(analysis_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM type_counts
), averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.tradekind, s.analysis_count, s.share,
       s.share - a.average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share
ORDER BY s.tradekind NULLS FIRST;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row counts as one analysis; exact foreign-key text equality defines a match, and unmatched rows are excluded by the inner joins. A NULL tradekind is retained as its own group. The plain average is the arithmetic mean of shares for trader types represented among matched analyses.
